name: Cooking Recipes, Ingredient Transformation & Camp Kitchen Runtime
design_rules: recipes require explicit ingredients tools and cooking time
cooking transforms ingredients rather than creating food from nothing
yield can be lower or higher than input mass depending on water and moisture changes
cooking improves safety when adequate heat and time are applied
overcooking may reduce nutrient retention and yield
recipes can combine nutrition and water systems into one meal
recipe outputs persist as food items with their own safety and nutrition state
camp cooking never uses emissive or glow feedback
